completed: Implemented baseline/proposed-method evaluation completed: 20 original pipelines, 18 registered stress pipelines, and 10 post-audit sensitivity pipelines; five outer seeds 11,23,37,53,71 preserved. Reported batch wall times were approximately 268 s, 7 s, and 251 s respectively on single-thread CPU. This is execution completion, not satisfaction of every frozen criterion.

Train-only Gaussian shrinkage and validation-selected masked ALS comparisons completed within the frozen grids and 200-iteration cap; all implemented methods and same-anchor imputer comparisons are represented in the result artifacts.

Original MTEB feasibility assessed and failed: only 1/5 organization splits met the prospective gate. All five retained for descriptive reporting; original panels contain eight candidates and four audit tasks.

Exploratory wide-native MTEB completed for all five seeds: 61-task panels with 49 candidates and 12 audit tasks, evaluated only on fixed observed per-row support. Metadata-connected OpenLLM sensitivity completed with reported zero nonempty SHA/base-key/component overlap; neither extension restores confirmation.

Core tables, contrast tables, conditional 2,000-draw clustered summaries, cohort counts, curves, resource diagnostics, and post-audit sensitivity artifacts are available. Original MTEB residual greedy NMSE 0.357 versus random 0.421 gives 15.1% descriptive reduction, conditional 95% CI [9.7%,20.6%]. Wide-native MTEB gives 0.239 versus 0.296, 19.3%; connected OpenLLM gives 0.429 versus 0.500, 14.2%.

Four contract tests passed; an independent audit reconstructed archived base losses and checked pairing/train-only mechanics; one full MTEB rerun reproduced its 3,520-record CSV exactly. The 100,000-sample Gaussian identity check is consistent with Monte Carlo error: discrepancies are within about 1.3 MCSE, not uniformly within one MCSE.
unmet_success_signals: Original >=3/5 feasible organization-split gate failed; C1 cannot be declared supported despite a positive descriptive effect and interval. C3 wording that requires confirmed C1 is likewise unavailable.

No full62 per-model prediction evidence: original evaluation uses 12-task panels; broader exploratory evaluation uses 61 eligible tasks with incomplete observed audit support, not complete suite ground truth.

Original OpenLLM splits have revision-alias overlap. Connected-metadata exploratory splits address recorded keys, not all shared ancestry, pristine holdout status, or population-independent transfer. Connected seed71 has a 70.3% test fraction and must not be described as approximately 60/20/20.

No unique residual-greedy superiority or algorithm novelty established. Wide-native audit greedy 0.228, correlation coverage 0.223, and mean-filled covariance 0.217 all have lower point NMSE than residual greedy 0.239; these rankings alone do not establish inferential superiority. C2 lacks the required validation-locked strongest-comparator/noninferiority evidence.

Frozen-plan complete-training-row covariance, intentionally wrong pre-acquisition-variance diagnostic, and standardized-variance tie comparator were omitted. Selected original MTEB low-rank fits hit the iteration cap. Stress covers six Gaussian/mean variants on three fixed seeds, not full low-rank robustness.

Native full-panel residual selection does not optimize the scored observed-support deployment objective. Some frozen selected budgets lack native evaluation records. Deployment targets vary by policy and cannot substitute for fixed-audit evidence.

A fully sealed, externally timestamped test history was not established; schema-head scores were materialized and resolved-lock/cache identity coverage was incomplete. Training deduplication, evaluator-version harmonization, and canonical tie behavior have documented deviations. Final manuscript, claim ledger, packaging checksums, and current disk verification remain reporting tasks.
